DDL	CREATE DATABASE showdb
SESSION	USE showdb
DDL	CREATE TABLE tbl(a STRING, b INT, c STRING, d STRING) USING parquet
DDL	CREATE VIEW view_1 AS SELECT * FROM tbl
DDL	CREATE VIEW view_2 AS SELECT * FROM tbl WHERE c='a'
DDL	CREATE GLOBAL TEMP VIEW view_3 AS SELECT 1 as col1
SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW view_4(e INT) USING parquet
READ	SHOW VIEWS
READ	SHOW VIEWS FROM showdb
READ	SHOW VIEWS IN showdb
READ	SHOW VIEWS IN global_temp
READ	SHOW VIEWS 'view_*'
READ	SHOW VIEWS LIKE 'view_1*|view_2*'
READ	SHOW VIEWS IN showdb 'view_*'
READ	SHOW VIEWS IN showdb LIKE 'view_*'
READ	SHOW VIEWS IN wrongdb LIKE 'view_*'
DDL	DROP VIEW global_temp.view_3
SESSION	DROP VIEW view_4
SESSION	USE default
DDL	DROP DATABASE showdb CASCADE
